name: Austria
scene: a turquoise Alpine lake below snow-topped peaks, a village with an onion-domed church tower, a yellow-and-white Baroque palace with a formal garden, a vintage tram, gentians in the foreground

name: Croatia
scene: a walled, terracotta-roofed Adriatic old town on a headland with a bell tower and stone harbour, a turquoise bay with white sailboats, cypress and pine, lavender, a limestone island beyond

name: Ireland
scene: tall green sea cliffs above a deep blue Atlantic, a round stone tower and a ruined abbey arch, dry-stone walls round small green fields, a whitewashed thatched cottage, sheep, a rainbow after a soft shower (no shamrocks, harps or leprechauns)

name: Vietnam
scene: an emerald bay of limestone towers with a red-sailed wooden junk, a lantern-hung old-town street with a covered bridge, terraced rice hills, a lotus pond, conical hats as shapes (no faces)
palette: jade green, lantern red, lotus pink

name: Morocco
scene: a rose-red walled medina with a tall square minaret at sunset, a keyhole-arched doorway tiled in abstract geometric patterns, a camel train on golden dunes, palms, mounds of coloured spice (no script, even as pattern)

name: Egypt
scene: three stepped-triangle pyramids at golden hour on the desert's edge, a felucca with a white sail on the Nile, date palms, a temple with papyrus-bud columns, a camel silhouette, a strip of turquoise Red Sea (no hieroglyphs)
palette: desert gold, Nile turquoise, lapis blue

name: Hungary
scene: a grand riverside Gothic Revival parliament-like building with a dome and many spires (not an exact copy) reflected in a wide river, a chain suspension bridge, a hilltop castle, a steaming domed thermal bath, strings of red paprika, a yellow tram
